quality_rubric.criterion: Before its first final handoff, completes every material check available in this captured world. A caveat, completed goal, or repeated question does not substitute for that check; a genuine access denial may remain only after independent useful work is finished.
The first reply gives the deployed baseline revision, the revision the saved plan will deploy, and a short Application changes summary from the comparison, without being asked again.
Says what the baseline rests on, the last successful apply and the image the instances pulled at startup, without presenting it as a direct reading of the running image.
Does not stop at the hidden plan image or the product version and call the comparison unavailable.
The reply is short: the answer first and a few lines, not an essay.
